profile.name: Satyaprakash Dwivedi
profile.headline: Engineering leader · Data platforms · AI engineering
profile.summary: Engineering leader with 14+ years building data platforms, now rebuilding hands-on as an AI/ML architect. These are the open-source projects I'm actively working on: streaming data pipelines, Spark performance tooling, and agentic AI built with a team of AI coding agents.

focus.title: Streaming data platforms
focus.text: Spark Structured Streaming and Kafka pipelines that are config-driven, tested and production-shaped.

focus.title: Data quality & reliability
focus.text: Great Expectations, quarantine streams, checkpoints, and performance tuning from real Spark logs.

focus.title: AI-assisted engineering
focus.text: Claude skills and multi-agent workflows that turn expertise into tools anyone on a team can use.

spark-streaming-pipeline-py.title: Spark Streaming Pipelines: PySpark
spark-streaming-pipeline-py.summary: Config-driven Spark Structured Streaming for Python teams. Describe source, transforms and sinks in YAML; it wires and runs the streaming queries.
highlights: Real Great Expectations validation on every micro-batch, including table-level checks
Row-level quality rules with a quarantine stream that records why each row failed
dbt models as streaming business rules; pandas UDFs and plain Python functions as steps
Runs via spark-submit, Databricks or Kubernetes · 45 tests in CI

spark-streaming-pipeline.title: Spark Streaming Pipelines: Java
spark-streaming-pipeline.summary: The JVM version of the same idea: one small jar for spark-submit, pipelines defined in HOCON, same step types and options as the PySpark twin.
highlights: Kafka, file and JDBC sources and sinks; JSON, SQL, lookup-join, watermark and dedup transforms
Data quality with Great Expectations suite import; dbt models compiled and run in the stream
A Claude skill that builds a pipeline from just source, rules and sink

spark-optimizer-skill.title: Spark Optimizer: Claude Skill
spark-optimizer-skill.summary: Point it at Spark event logs and executor logs; it measures what went wrong and recommends a conflict-free Spark config.
highlights: Detects skew, spill, GC pressure, wrongly sized shuffle partitions, idle executors
Tells heap OOM apart from container kills (exit 137) and shifts memory from heap to overhead
Sizes executors to your nodes so heap + overhead + Python memory always fit

ai-engineering-portfolio.title: AI Engineering Portfolio
ai-engineering-portfolio.summary: A 16-week hands-on program: classical ML, deep learning, RAG, tool calling and MCP, LangGraph agents, multi-agent systems, fine-tuning and LLMOps, each as a measured module.
highlights: Built as tech lead directing a team of AI coding agents (Claude Code subagents + AI PR review)
Hybrid model routing: Claude API plus local models via Ollama

capstone-data-platform-copilot.title: Data Platform Copilot
capstone-data-platform-copilot.summary: Capstone: a multi-agent LangGraph system for data platform teams that answers data questions, checks data quality, triages pipeline incidents and finds runbook answers, with human approval before actions.
highlights: Supervisor, NL→SQL, data-quality, runbook-RAG and incident-triage agents
Designed to be cost-aware, evaluated and observable
